forecast.command: GPUWM_HISTORY_COMPRESSION=none python -m gpuwm.cli go --wrfinput INPUT --outdir OUTPUT --rrtmg-variant rrtmg_legacy --allow-shared-gpu --no-supervise --products none
forecast.initial_input_limit: Original shared real.exe pair disappeared during native integration. Boundary recovered with original SHA; retained native initial-history fields unchanged, with AL/ALB/T_INIT rebuilt by existing cold-start authority.
forecast.compression_limit: Installed Rust writer lacks the NetCDF4 creation ABI; declared uncompressed Rust history path used.
forecast.visual_result: Same broad thermal gradient, moisture corridor, surface low and wind pattern, with small local differences; no striping or unstable surface-field pattern.
forecast.unavailable_visual: Renderer rejected var:PBLH despite the native and GPU raw history variables. PBLH compared numerically only.
forecast.observation_method: nearest 12-km grid cell; dewpoint from Q2 mixing ratio and PSFC with 17.67/243.5 Magnus relation; station coordinates from pinned NOAA metadata
forecast.observation_limit: Three stations and twelve station-hour samples in one case; no general skill claim.

optimization_identity.method: Rust raw dump with mask and scale disabled; exact finite f32 to f64 widening

stage_timing.method: CUDA events, three warmups then five samples, same tiled real captured columns
stage_timing.physics_cost: KEPS carries and solves TKE, dissipation and TPE, uses an analytic coupled source closure, and performs eight implicit diffusion solves. The full Bougeault search remains when the dissipation repair consumes it.
stage_timing.optimization: Skipping the unused Bougeault search reduced KEPS from 5.652480 to 2.639872 ms on this card; no consuming-branch or forecast words changed.
stage_timing.nonconsuming_search: All seven native captures had no DLS consumer. A planted control forces 3456 consuming levels and compares 60048 words with zero differences.
stage_timing.qualification: historical tiled replay microbenchmark; not current forecast qualification
stage_timing.qualification_note: The 1.5548x physics-cost exception is withdrawn. Current same-commit interleaved forecast evidence is recorded separately.
